body:
## Summary
- Players can pin up to six games from the lobby when the web `pin-games` control point is on. Pin and unpin stay on the existing API with no API control point.
- Every bot now chooses from the board. Memory and Dots & Boxes no longer pick a random legal move, and the weaker bots search or score the position instead of playing the first empty cell.

## Test plan
- [ ] With `pin-games` on, pin and unpin a game in the lobby and confirm the Pinned row updates.
- [ ] Confirm pin is rejected at the six-game limit and the error shows in the lobby.
- [ ] With the flag off, the lobby has no pin controls.
- [ ] Play Memory and Dots & Boxes and confirm the bot repeats the same reply on the same board.
- [ ] Play Hexapawn, Mancala, Reversi, and Wild Tic-Tac-Toe and confirm the bot answers instead of stalling.


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
title: Add lobby pins and decisive bots
